name: Party Status Advice V 01
definition: Scope:|The PartyStatusAdvice message is sent by the executing party to the instructing party to provide details about the processing of a request on party reference data (create or update).||Usage:|When processing information is negative - a failure occurred in applying the changes the message accordingly also delivers information about the reason why the creation or update could not be processed.|When processing is successfully performed, the message includes the related party identification.

MessageHeader.name: Message Header
MessageHeader.definition: Common business identification for the message.

PartyStatus.name: Party Status
PartyStatus.definition: Status of the party involved in the originating message.

SupplementaryData.name: Supplementary Data
SupplementaryData.definition: Additional information that cannot be captured in the structured elements and/or any other specific block.
